_comment: Texts used only by the Android app. Shared texts live in shared.json (generated, do not duplicate them here).

Glassbed needs access to your local netw.en: Glassbed needs access to your local network to find and use your printer. It connects to nothing else.
Glassbed needs access to your local netw.de: Glassbed braucht Zugriff auf dein lokales Netzwerk, um deinen Drucker zu finden und zu nutzen. Mit nichts anderem wird eine Verbindung hergestellt.
Glassbed needs access to your local netw.tr: Glassbed, yazıcınızı bulmak ve kullanmak için yerel ağınıza erişmeye ihtiyaç duyar. Başka hiçbir yere bağlanmaz.

Without access to the local network Glas.en: Without access to the local network Glassbed cannot reach your printer. You can allow it in the system settings.
Without access to the local network Glas.de: Ohne Zugriff auf das lokale Netzwerk kann Glassbed deinen Drucker nicht erreichen. Du kannst ihn in den Systemeinstellungen erlauben.
Without access to the local network Glas.tr: Yerel ağa erişim olmadan Glassbed yazıcınıza ulaşamaz. Bu izni sistem ayarlarından verebilirsiniz.

Only devices on the local network can be.en: Only devices on the local network can be used ({host}).
Only devices on the local network can be.de: Es können nur Geräte im lokalen Netzwerk verwendet werden ({host}).

The printer does not respond. Check the.en: The printer does not respond. Check the address and the Wi-Fi connection.
The printer does not respond. Check the.de: Der Drucker antwortet nicht. Prüfe die Adresse und die WLAN-Verbindung.
The printer does not respond. Check the.tr: Yazıcı yanıt vermiyor. Adresi ve Wi-Fi bağlantısını kontrol edin.

Could not connect to the printer..en: Could not connect to the printer.

One file per page: name_001, name_002, ….en: One file per page: name_001, name_002, …
One file per page: name_001, name_002, ….de: Eine Datei je Seite: Name_001, Name_002, …
One file per page: name_001, name_002, ….tr: Sayfa başına bir dosya: ad_001, ad_002, …

{n} scanned page(s) have not been saved..en: {n} scanned page(s) have not been saved. Leave anyway?
{n} scanned page(s) have not been saved..de: {n} gescannte Seite(n) wurden nicht gespeichert. Trotzdem beenden?
{n} scanned page(s) have not been saved..tr: Taranan {n} sayfa kaydedilmedi. Yine de çıkmak istiyor musunuz?

{n} scanned page(s) have not been saved..en: {n} scanned page(s) have not been saved. Remove them anyway?
{n} scanned page(s) have not been saved..de: {n} gescannte Seite(n) wurden nicht gespeichert. Trotzdem entfernen?
{n} scanned page(s) have not been saved..tr: Taranan {n} sayfa kaydedilmedi. Yine de kaldırmak istiyor musunuz?

Your changes to this page will be lost..en: Your changes to this page will be lost.
Your changes to this page will be lost..de: Deine Änderungen an dieser Seite gehen verloren.

Drag the corners or edges to crop..en: Drag the corners or edges to crop.
Drag the corners or edges to crop..de: Ziehe an den Ecken oder Kanten, um zuzuschneiden.
Drag the corners or edges to crop..tr: Kırpmak için köşeleri veya kenarları sürükleyin.

Draw a box with one finger. Pinch to zoo.en: Draw a box with one finger. Pinch to zoom, move with two fingers.
Draw a box with one finger. Pinch to zoo.de: Zieh mit einem Finger ein Rechteck auf. Mit zwei Fingern zoomen und verschieben.
Draw a box with one finger. Pinch to zoo.tr: Tek parmakla bir alan çizin. İki parmakla yakınlaştırın ve kaydırın.

Glassbed only talks to your printer on t.en: Glassbed only talks to your printer on the local network. No accounts, no tracking.
Glassbed only talks to your printer on t.de: Glassbed spricht nur mit deinem Drucker im lokalen Netzwerk. Kein Konto, kein Tracking.
Glassbed only talks to your printer on t.tr: Glassbed yalnızca yerel ağdaki yazıcınızla iletişim kurar. Hesap yok, izleme yok.

The printer is out of paper. Load paper.en: The printer is out of paper. Load paper and try again.
The printer is out of paper. Load paper.de: Der Drucker hat kein Papier mehr. Lege Papier ein und versuch es noch einmal.
The printer is out of paper. Load paper.tr: Yazıcıda kâğıt kalmadı. Kâğıt yerleştirip tekrar deneyin.

Paper jam. Remove the jammed paper and t.en: Paper jam. Remove the jammed paper and try again.
Paper jam. Remove the jammed paper and t.de: Papierstau. Entferne das gestaute Papier und versuch es noch einmal.
Paper jam. Remove the jammed paper and t.tr: Kâğıt sıkışması. Sıkışan kâğıdı çıkarıp tekrar deneyin.

A cover or door of the printer is open..en: A cover or door of the printer is open. Close it and try again.
A cover or door of the printer is open..de: Eine Klappe oder Tür des Druckers ist offen. Schließ sie und versuch es noch einmal.
A cover or door of the printer is open..tr: Yazıcının bir kapağı veya kapısı açık. Kapatıp tekrar deneyin.

The toner is empty. Replace the cartridg.en: The toner is empty. Replace the cartridge and try again.
The toner is empty. Replace the cartridg.de: Der Toner ist leer. Tausch die Kartusche und versuch es noch einmal.
The toner is empty. Replace the cartridg.tr: Toner bitti. Kartuşu değiştirip tekrar deneyin.

The printer is paused. Resume it on the.en: The printer is paused. Resume it on the printer and try again.
The printer is paused. Resume it on the.de: Der Drucker ist angehalten. Setz ihn am Gerät fort und versuch es noch einmal.
The printer is paused. Resume it on the.tr: Yazıcı duraklatıldı. Yazıcıda devam ettirip tekrar deneyin.

The printer is busy. Try again in a mome.en: The printer is busy. Try again in a moment.
The printer is busy. Try again in a mome.de: Der Drucker ist beschäftigt. Versuch es gleich noch einmal.
The printer is busy. Try again in a mome.tr: Yazıcı meşgul. Biraz sonra tekrar deneyin.

The printer reports a problem. Check the.en: The printer reports a problem. Check the printer's display.
The printer reports a problem. Check the.de: Der Drucker meldet ein Problem. Sieh auf dem Display des Druckers nach.
The printer reports a problem. Check the.tr: Yazıcı bir sorun bildiriyor. Yazıcının ekranını kontrol edin.

The printer cannot print this format..en: The printer cannot print this format.
The printer cannot print this format..de: Der Drucker kann dieses Format nicht drucken.

The printer rejected the job..de: Der Drucker hat den Auftrag abgelehnt.

Add PDFs or images to print. You can als.en: Add PDFs or images to print. You can also share them to Glassbed from another app.
Add PDFs or images to print. You can als.de: Füge PDFs oder Bilder zum Drucken hinzu. Du kannst sie auch aus einer anderen App an Glassbed teilen.
Add PDFs or images to print. You can als.tr: Yazdırmak için PDF veya resim ekleyin. Bunları başka bir uygulamadan Glassbed ile de paylaşabilirsiniz.

Only PDF, JPEG and PNG files can be prin.en: Only PDF, JPEG and PNG files can be printed.
Only PDF, JPEG and PNG files can be prin.de: Es können nur PDF-, JPEG- und PNG-Dateien gedruckt werden.
Only PDF, JPEG and PNG files can be prin.tr: Yalnızca PDF, JPEG ve PNG dosyaları yazdırılabilir.

Scans the original and prints it at 100.en: Scans the original and prints it at 100 %. The copy is not added to the pages.
Scans the original and prints it at 100.de: Scannt die Vorlage und druckt sie in 100 %. Die Kopie wird nicht zu den Seiten hinzugefügt.
Scans the original and prints it at 100.tr: Belgeyi tarar ve %100 boyutunda yazdırır. Kopya sayfalara eklenmez.
